title: Your bag has 12 minutes
scenario: You are already through security when a text says the payment for your checked bag failed. It knows your flight number and warns the bag will be offloaded unless you pay €35 within 12 minutes.

answers.A: Show the message to airline staff or check the bag status in the airline app you open yourself.
answers.B: Search the airline website and call a support number you find there before paying.
answers.C: Use the text link but pay with a virtual card so your main card stays protected.

explanation: A safer card does not make an unverified payment request safe. First confirm that the charge exists through a channel you control.
proTip: Real urgency is a reason to verify faster, not skip verification.
